name: aviala-name-helper
description: Figma plugin that builds and validates --aviala-{category}-{property}-{variant}-{state} design-token names, powered by Spiral 2.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n main,ui -c blue,green "vite build --config vite.config.main.ts --watch --mode development" "vite build --config vite.config.ui.ts --watch --mode development"
scripts.build: pnpm clean && vite build --config vite.config.main.ts && vite build --config vite.config.ui.ts
scripts.verify: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
